def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required_symbols = set(case["required_symbols"])
    # Build maps
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        node_id = n["id"]
        node_map[node_id] = n
        parent = n["parent"]
        if parent is not None:
            children.setdefault(parent, []).append(node_id)
    # Initially all retained
    retained = set(node_map.keys())
    removed_order = []
    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then id ascending
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda x: (-x["depth"], x["id"]))
    # Precompute symbol counts to check removal
    # We'll maintain a symbol count dict
    symbol_counts = {}
    for n in nodes:
        sym = n["symbol"]
        symbol_counts[sym] = symbol_counts.get(sym, 0) + 1
    # Also we need to know for each node, how many of its symbol exist currently.
    # We'll update counts as we remove.
    for n in sorted_nodes:
        node_id = n["id"]
        if not n["removable"]:
            continue
        # Check if node has any retained children
        child_ids = children.get(node_id, [])
        has_retained_child = any(cid in retained for cid in child_ids)
        if has_retained_child:
            continue
        # Check required symbols condition
        # If we remove this node, will any required symbol become missing?
        sym = n["symbol"]
        # If this node's symbol is required, we need that symbol count >1
        if sym in required_symbols:
            if symbol_counts[sym] <= 1:
                continue  # would lose required symbol
        # Also need to consider other required symbols unaffected because we only decrement one symbol count.
        # So safe.
        # Remove node
        retained.remove(node_id)
        removed_order.append(node_id)
        symbol_counts[sym] -= 1
    # Sorted retained ids (ascending string order)
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {
        "removed_node_ids": removed_order,
        "retained_node_ids": retained_sorted
    }
